title: Industrial and Official Statistics
curriculum_locator: Stat H-305 Industrial and Official Statistics; University of Dhaka four-year B.S. Honours Statistics curriculum, starting session 2023–2024

units.title: Foundations of Statistical Quality Control & Shewhart Control Charts for Variables
scope: Philosophy of industrial quality control: Walter Shewhart, W. Edwards Deming, Joseph Juran, and the PDCA improvement cycle
Statistical process control concepts: common causes vs assignable causes of variation, process stability, and the 3-sigma control principle
Shewhart X-bar and R control charts: design, control limit derivations via d_2 and d_3 factor constants, Phase I and Phase II implementation
Shewhart X-bar and S control charts for larger subgroup sizes: unbiasing constants c_4, control limits, and variance estimation
Operating Characteristic (OC) curves and Average Run Length (ARL) of Shewhart charts: type I error probability alpha, type II error beta, ARL_0 and ARL_1
Sensitizing rules for Shewhart charts: Western Electric rules, Nelson rules, warning limits, and their effect on false alarm rates

units.title: Process Capability Analysis, Tolerance Synthesis & Measurement Systems Evaluation
scope: Distinction between process control limits and specification tolerances: Lower Specification Limit (LSL) and Upper Specification Limit (USL)
Potential process capability index C_p: derivation, interpretation, and relationship to six-sigma defect rates
Actual process capability index C_pk: accounting for process centering, calculation of upper and lower capability ratios C_pu and C_pl
Taguchi capability index C_pm: penalizing deviation from target value T, derivation of expected quadratic loss
Sampling distributions and confidence intervals for C_p and C_pk estimators under Gaussian process assumptions
Measurement systems analysis (Gage R&R): repeatability, reproducibility, ANOVA method vs X-bar/R method, and precision-to-tolerance (P/T) ratio

units.title: Control Charts for Attributes: Proportion, Nonconforming Units & Defect Count Models
scope: Classification of quality characteristics: variables vs attributes, nonconforming items vs nonconformities (defects)
The p-chart for fraction nonconforming: binomial distribution foundation, 3-sigma limits, and handling zero lower control limits
Handling variable subgroup sizes in p-charts: exact individual control limits, standardized p-charts, and average sample size approximation
The np-chart for number of nonconforming units: constant sample size requirements and direct count monitoring
The c-chart for count of defects: Poisson distribution foundation, 3-sigma limits, and probability limits vs 3-sigma limits
The u-chart for average defects per inspection unit with varying inspection areas: derivation and overdispersion diagnostics

units.title: Advanced Statistical Process Monitoring: CUSUM, EWMA & Multivariate SPC
scope: Limitations of standard Shewhart charts for detecting small, persistent process shifts (0.5 to 1.5 standard deviations)
Cumulative Sum (CUSUM) control chart: tabular (algorithmic) two-sided CUSUM, reference value k, decision interval h, and V-mask equivalence
Designing CUSUM parameters for target in-control ARL_0 and out-of-control ARL_1: Siegmund's approximation and Markov chain models
Exponentially Weighted Moving Average (EWMA) control chart: smoothing parameter lambda, exact time-varying vs steady-state asymptotic limits
Multivariate statistical process control: Hotelling's T^2 control chart for sub-grouped and individual observations, decomposed out-of-control signals
Multivariate EWMA (MEWMA) and principal component monitoring for high-dimensional industrial process sensor streams

units.title: Acceptance Sampling Quality Assurance: Attributes & Variables Inspection Systems
scope: Foundations of acceptance sampling: lot-by-lot inspection vs 100% inspection vs zero inspection; economic rationale and role in vendor quality
Single sampling plans for attributes (N, n, c): Operating Characteristic (OC) curves via hypergeometric, binomial, and Poisson models
Key quality parameters: Acceptance Quality Limit (AQL), Lot Tolerance Percent Defective (LTPD / LQ), Producer's Risk alpha, Consumer's Risk beta
Rectifying inspection programs: Average Outgoing Quality (AOQ), Average Outgoing Quality Limit (AOQL), and Average Total Inspection (ATI)
Double and multiple sampling plans: decision criteria, ASN curves, and inspection cost efficiency compared to single sampling
Variables acceptance sampling: known vs unknown sigma plans, k-method, and MIL-STD-105E / ANSI/ASQ Z1.4 standardization frameworks

units.title: System Reliability Engineering, Failure Rate Physics & Accelerated Life Testing
scope: Fundamental mathematical objects of reliability: lifetime random variable T, survival/reliability function R(t), hazard rate h(t), cumulative hazard H(t)
Mean Time To Failure (MTTF) and Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF): integral relationships with R(t)
Parametric failure time models: exponential (memoryless property), Weibull (shape parameter beta governing wear-out, burn-in, random failures), lognormal
System reliability modeling: series systems, parallel redundant systems, k-out-of-n voting systems, and standby redundancy with switching
Censored life data analysis: Type I (time) censoring, Type II (failure) censoring, and random censoring likelihood constructions
Accelerated Life Testing (ALT): Arrhenius reaction rate model, inverse power law, and extrapolation to normal operational stress levels

units.title: National Statistical Systems, SNA Framework & Macroeconomic Output Measurement
scope: Architecture of official statistics: UN Fundamental Principles of Official Statistics, National Statistical Offices (NSOs), and data governance
System of National Accounts (SNA): macroeconomic identities, production boundary, institutional sectors, and supply-use tables
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) estimation: production approach (gross value added), expenditure approach (C + I + G + NX), and income approach
Deflation and price indices: Laspeyres, Paasche, and Fisher ideal price index numbers; axiomatic and economic test properties; chain volume indices
Consumer Price Index (CPI): basket selection, geometric averaging at elementary levels (Jevons, Dutot, Carli indices), and inflation rate computation
Industrial statistics frameworks: International Standard Industrial Classification (ISIC), Index of Industrial Production (IIP), and manufacturing surveys

units.title: Social, Labor, Poverty & Sustainable Development Statistics in Official Governance
scope: Labor force statistics: International Labour Organization (ILO) standards, working-age population, labor force participation rate, unemployment definition
Underemployment and labor underutilization measures (LU1 to LU4), informal employment measurement, and Decent Work indicators
Poverty measurement methodologies: absolute vs relative poverty lines, cost-of-basic-needs (CBN) method, and poverty headcount ratio
Foster-Greer-Thorbecke (FGT) class of poverty metrics: headcount ratio P_0, poverty gap index P_1, and squared poverty gap (severity) P_2
Income and consumption inequality: Lorenz curves, Gini coefficient derivation and decomposition, Palma ratio, and Theil's entropy index
Multidimensional poverty index (MPI) and Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) monitoring indicator frameworks and administrative data registers
